newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar accuses Bahrain of aiding February coup.
newsitem.headline: Qatar accuses Bahrain of aiding February coup.

text.p: Qatar on Monday accused Bahrain of participating in a failed coup attempt in Qatar in February and said its crown prince was still plotting against Doha.
"They (Bahrain) participated in the coup under the leadership of the crown prince (Sheikh Hamad bin Isa al-Khalifa)," Qatar's foreign minister told a news conference.
Bahrain "was the centre for the conspiracy...(smuggling) the weapons and explosives" into Qatar, said the Qatari minister, Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani.
He also accused Bahrain, a fellow member of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), of bugging the rooms of the Qatari delegation when Manama hosted the annual GCC summit in 1994.
Bahrain and Qatar are locked in a decades-old dispute over a cluster of Gulf islands held by Bahrain and claimed by Doha.

Qatar said in February it had arrested 100 people in connection with an anti-government plot involving former bodyguards loyal to the deposed emir Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad al-Thani, who was overthrown in a bloodless palace coup in 1995 by his son, the current Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani.

"Until now he (Bahrain's crown prince) is continuing in the plotting...it is not for free. He is being paid for it," said the Qatari minister in Doha's first official accusation of Bahrain of involvement in the coup attempt.
Bahrain boycotted this year's GCC summit which closed in Qatar on Monday. Last week it put two Qataris on trial on spying charges.
The Qatari minister reiterated Doha's position that the charges against the two were "fabricated".
Delegates said the GCC summit agreed to a hold a foreign ministers' session later in the month outside of Qatar to try to narrow the differences between the two small states.
The other members of the GCC are Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait and Oman.
The Qatari minister also announced that Qatar's emir would travel to Rome on Tuesday to have lunch with his father.
The former emir "is our father and we will take care of him," added the minister.
